text: With crook = lean-low, the storeroom wall's intact newer half is full of the 'forbidden' words in new spelling: (tree horn)(lean-low horn) ×4 = old (tree seed)(crook seed); (lean-low horn)(seed+arch moon) ×4 = D4; (box-curl arrow)(door+dot arrow) ×3 = D1. It also has the sanctum formula's crook phrase as (lean-low moon)(mbox-sweep horn)(box-point horn). Someone scraped the old-style copy but left the same words standing in the new script.
